description: Return a deterministic ordered time series of normalized EDGAR facts for one metric. Deterministic ordering is period_end ASC, fiscal_year ASC, fiscal_period ASC, statement_type ASC, with a fixed tie-break so pages never overlap. When as_of_date is supplied, only filings public by that date are included.

as_of_date.description: Return values only from filings public by this date, as they stood on it.

as_reported.description: Return each period's value as first reported rather than as last restated.

cik.description: Company CIK as digits (for example 0000320193), or a ticker symbol (for example AAPL). A ticker resolves to the company whose filings hold its statements as of the request's as-of or period-end date, or as of today when the request has none.

fiscal_period.description: Return only this fiscal period: FY with period_type annual, or one of Q1 to Q4 with period_type quarterly or ttm.

fiscal_year_from.description: Return only fiscal years at or after this year.

fiscal_year_to.description: Return only fiscal years at or before this year.

include_provenance.description: Include the filing and XBRL fact each value was read from.

metric.description: Canonical metric code, for example REVENUE: a GET /v1/metrics/definitions entry with is_canonical true.

period_type.description: Periods to return: annual (the default), quarterly, or ttm for trailing twelve months.

statement_type.description: Statement to read the metric from: INCOME_STATEMENT, BALANCE_SHEET or CASH_FLOW_STATEMENT. Omit to read every statement that carries the metric, with a row for each.

name: edgar_companies_metrics_time_series
title: Get normalized metric time series
